items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: No, I didn't know him personally, but I knew of him.

ctx.x: Yeah. But you were born, you weren't born on a plantation? No, no. What's your birthday exactly? What's your birthday?

July 14th, 1893. Quatorze, yeah. Yeah. You know what that is? A St. Bernard Parish. Yeah. Do you speak French? No, no. Did your parents speak French? Yeah, they did, but they didn't speak with us, with the children, because they used that, so they wanted to say something they didn't want us to know, they'd talk French, and that's why they were taught now. Did you know Jimbo from down there? No, I didn't know him personally, but I knew of him.
The clarinet play I'm talking about? Yeah. Jimmy Newman? Yeah, I knew of him, but I didn't know him. He was from down there, I can't remember, one of those big plantations, did he?
